a: Keep state local unless many distant components need the same data.
Redux Toolkit simplifies Redux with slices and immutable updates helpers.
Zustand is a minimal React state library with hooks.
Jotai uses atomic state pieces that components subscribe to selectively.
Server state belongs in query libraries; UI state in component/store.
Normalize entities by id to avoid deeply nested duplication.
Derive values with selectors/computed instead of storing duplicates.
State machines (XState) model complex UI flows explicitly.
Filters/pagination in the URL make views shareable and back-button friendly.
Update UI immediately, roll back if the server rejects the change.
